name: Metformin
commonUses: First-line medicine to control blood sugar levels in Type 2 Diabetes. It decreases glucose production in the liver and improves body insulin response.
precautions: Take with meals to prevent stomach irritation. Drink plenty of water to keep kidneys healthy.
warnings: Do not take if you have severe kidney disease (eGFR below 30). Avoid heavy drinking to prevent lactic acidosis.
source: WHO Essential Medicine List & Jan Swasthya Kendra Guidelines
